wv_entrance_walls.blurb: Entrance Walls sits where Smoke Hole Canyon begins, beside the South Branch of the Potomac, a short drive from Upper Tract and Franklin. It is mostly a sport crag with about thirty lines, plus a handful of trad climbs. Most routes fall in the 5.8 to 5.9 range, with a smaller group of 5.11s and one 5.12, so it suits moderate leaders well. The cliffs are modest in height, and the walk from the road is very short. A north-facing arch close to the water gives some of the shadier climbing. Anchors are typically bolts with rings or open hardware, so carry your own gear if you plan to top-rope.
